    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">基于.net6的一款开源的低代码、权限、工作流、动态接口平台-动态数据源篇</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>动态数据源</h1>
<div>动态数据源功能允许用户在运行时动态添加、修改和删除数据库连接信息，从而实现对多个数据库的访问和操作。通过动态数据源，用户可以根据业务需求灵活地管理和切换数据库连接，提高系统的扩展性和灵活性。</div>
<h2><a id="user-content-动态数据源配置" class="anchor" href="https://gitee.com/Jesai/platform/blob/master/Doc/DynamicDataSource.md#%E5%8A%A8%E6%80%81%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E6%BA%90%E9%85%8D%E7%BD%AE" rel="noopener nofollow"></a>动态数据源配置</h2>
<ol>
<li>打开动态数据源菜单</li>
</ol>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/751976/202511/751976-20251126221616461-747312653.png" alt="e7ddac7c-95aa-4950-94ec-fda32e3cb57b" width="1406" height="692" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<ol start="2">
<li>点击新增按钮，填写动态数据源信息</li>
</ol>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/751976/202511/751976-20251126221720590-1792911507.png" alt="微信图片_2025-11-23_224918_532" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<ol start="3">
<li>
<p>填写完毕，点击测试连接按钮，测试连接是否成功</p>
</li>
<li>
<div>
<div>点击确定按钮，保存动态数据源信息，列表可以看到新增的数据源记录。</div>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
<h2><a id="user-content-修改动态数据源" class="anchor" href="https://gitee.com/Jesai/platform/blob/master/Doc/DynamicDataSource.md#%E4%BF%AE%E6%94%B9%E5%8A%A8%E6%80%81%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E6%BA%90" rel="noopener nofollow"></a>修改动态数据源</h2>
<ol>
<li>打开动态数据源菜单</li>
<li>点击需要修改的动态数据源，进入修改页面</li>
<li>修改动态数据源信息</li>
<li>点击测试连接按钮，测试连接是否成功</li>
<li>点击确定按钮，保存动态数据源信息</li>
</ol>
<h2><a id="user-content-删除动态数据源" class="anchor" href="https://gitee.com/Jesai/platform/blob/master/Doc/DynamicDataSource.md#%E5%88%A0%E9%99%A4%E5%8A%A8%E6%80%81%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E6%BA%90" rel="noopener nofollow"></a>删除动态数据源</h2>
<ol>
<li>打开动态数据源菜单</li>
<li>点击需要删除的动态数据源，进入删除页面</li>
<li>点击删除按钮，删除动态数据源</li>
</ol>
<h2><a id="user-content-使用动态数据源" class="anchor" href="https://gitee.com/Jesai/platform/blob/master/Doc/DynamicDataSource.md#%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E5%8A%A8%E6%80%81%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E6%BA%90" rel="noopener nofollow"></a>使用动态数据源</h2>
<ol>
<li>代码里面使用动态数据源</li>
</ol>
<div class="markdown-code-block">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> db=provider.GetConnection(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Test</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).Result;

    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Handle(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> param){  

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">查询数据库</span>

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> db=provider.GetConnection(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Test</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).Result;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> data=db.Ado.SqlQuery&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">dynamic</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">select * from mlt_sys_dynamic_datasource</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> tableData = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[]
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { Id = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, TableName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用户表</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, TableCode = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, TableDesc = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用户信息表</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, IsValid = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, CreateTime = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2023-10-01 12:00:00</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { Id = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, TableName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">订单表</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, TableCode = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">order</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, TableDesc = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">订单信息表</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, IsValid = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, CreateTime = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2023-10-02 12:00:00</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },

        }
       
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task Main()
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> p= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Program();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result=p.Handle(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            Console.WriteLine(result);
        }
    }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<div>
<div><strong>&nbsp;注意事项</strong></div>
<div>- 动态数据源数据库链接目前是明文，可以自行修改为加密字符串，否组可能出现裸奔。</div>
<div><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">动态接口脚本管理这块，目前还没做权限管理，相当于裸奔，后续会加上：目前建议自己加上权限认证，或者最安全的办法是不要对公暴露。</span></div>
</div>
</div>
<p>开源地址：<a href="https://gitee.com/Jesai/platform.git" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">https://gitee.com/Jesai/platform.git</a></p>
<p>开源不易，看到麻烦顺手点个星星！</p>
